html:
Explore the beauty of Nha Trang Bay with Vietlook Travel on this exciting island-hopping tour. Swim in crystal-clear waters, snorkel among colorful coral reefs, experience local life at a floating fishing village, and relax at Mini Beach. Perfect for travelers seeking both adventure and relaxation.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30
Car and professional English-speaking tour guide pick you up at the meeting point.

Board a speed canoe to begin the island tour.

MUN ISLAND

09:15
Arrive at Mun Island.

Free time to swim, snorkel, and admire colorful coral reefs.

Swimming goggles and snorkels are provided.

Optional water activities are available at your own expense, such as jet ski, parasailing, scuba diving, sea walking, banana boat, and more.

FISHING VILLAGE

11:30
Visit the floating fishing village.

Enjoy lunch at a raft restaurant (lunch included in the tour).

The floating wooden raft restaurant features live tanks and nets filled with fish, lobster, crabs, and mussels (additional seafood may incur extra charges).

After lunch, free time to rest and relax.

MINI BEACH

12:30
Arrive at Mini Beach.

Free time to swim, relax, and enjoy the sea.

Optional water activities are available at your own expense, such as parasailing, jet ski, banana boat, and more.

15:30 – 16:00
Return to the mainland by canoe. End of the tour.

TOUR PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 32

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Hotel pick-up by car

  • Speed canoe transportation

  • Lunch at the island

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Bottled water

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses

  • Optional activities outside the program

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children under 1 meter: Free of charge

  • From 1m to 1.29m: 70% of adult price

  • From 1.29m and above: Adult price applies
